scope: Native foreground WebSocket probe with a three-second deadline, socket lifetime fencing and coalescing; repeated foreground reports also probe when local visibility has not changed.

checks.baseline: Old Core fails immediate foreground probe regression; intermediate version fails already-foreground regression.
checks.core: Locked mobile source interaction/conversation_msg/common passed CGO race detector; open_im_sdk compiled.
checks.stress: Foreground regression suite passed 10 repetitions with race detector.
checks.source_lock: 15 tests passed; 450 locked files; cumulative patch reproduces 447 files plus 3 declared overlays.
checks.android: Four-ABI AAR built; arm64 and x86_64 APKs built and native binary parity verified.

measurement.method: Drop only the established Core socket four-tuple in INPUT and OUTPUT; new connections remain allowed. Remove exact rules in finally. No outgoing chat messages.
measurement.clock: Device epoch from resume command to connection_recovered telemetry; not message synchronization or UI completion.
measurement.baseline_packaging: Same final x86_64 APK with only libgojni.so replaced by verified recovery.37 AAR library and re-signed with project signing configuration.

apk.parity: APK arm64 Core matches AAR after optional symbol stripping

emulator_apk.parity: APK x64 Core matches AAR after optional symbol stripping

graph.scope_note: Whole dirty-tree detect_changes reports critical across 13 pre-existing changed files; reviewed current scope and new files directly. Graph process coverage is bounded and does not prove absence of other callers.

limitations: Three controlled samples per condition on one emulator; not physical-device/P95 validation.
iOS shares locked source but Framework/App has not been rebuilt; macOS required.
Early arm64-on-x86 runs encountered libhoudini crashes in both versions and are excluded from final comparison.

Cold-start rapid-background runs on intermediate recovery.38.1 measured 5.459/14.488/14.438 seconds and motivated an additional repeated-foreground regression; final version adds a regression and probes repeated foreground reports.
Local connection confirmation is measured; full message catch-up, battery use and prolonged weak-network behavior are not measured.
